parsed.explanation: The combined national-plus-division regime is high-risk for an outed trans visitor. National document rules make passport or visa marker mismatch a border tripwire with refusal, detention, and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility; immigration custody has documented severe abuse. The division adds a universal public-building facility ban, including airports, enforced by private bounty suits and civil or criminal penalties, with no documented working injunction. National hate-crime and anti-discrimination law, existing X passports, active litigation, and some injunctions are real but do not reach the facility or border exposures. Minors face care restrictions and injunction uncertainty. The score sits below denial-of-entry-only anchors and near the lower high-risk anchors, above catastrophic imprisonment or execution scenarios.

entry_documents.exposure: National sex-at-birth rules; X-marker issuance stopped; border cable tags discrepancies, permits refusal, and can support lifetime fraud ineligibility; passports reported confiscated or blocked; foreign advisories.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; fraud finding not automatic and requires four elements; litigation and legal-aid FAQ; no blanket entry ban documented.
entry_documents.interaction: Foreign passport or visa checked at border; discrepancy can lead to secondary inspection, refusal, or detention; division airport facility law adds exposure after entry.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement, and sexual abuse of trans men; correctional conversion-like policies and care denial; visa-related detentions reported.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Border discrepancy or facility arrest can move a traveler into birth-sex custody, where documented abuses apply; national custody policies follow.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Division law confines trans people to birth-sex facilities in public buildings including airports; civil and criminal penalties up to $1,000 and private bounty suits; national order bars gender-congruent federally funded facilities; many state bans.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Some states and provinces have no ban; division public-accommodations law and pending suit exist, but no injunction against facility or bounty provisions is documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Airport is a covered public building; a visitor can be sued or penalized by a private person, independent of a prosecutor; national order overlaps.

care_services.exposure: Division bans gender-affirming care for minors; national orders and health rules restrict under-18 care and subpoena records; adult visitor HRT refill and emergency care exposure not documented.
care_services.protection: Division minor-care ban temporarily enjoined in May 2026; some national orders blocked; national hate-crime and anti-discrimination laws do not ensure care.
care_services.interaction: Adult with minor faces care-access uncertainty; adult alone faces outing in emergency or care settings but no documented visitor care ban.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy prioritizes 'radically pro-transgender' groups; justice-department reward memo references 'radical gender ideology'; executive order targets school support for trans minors; official hostility.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Strategy says it will not target mere disagreement; courts blocked some orders; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Raises severity if phone content or advocacy is examined at border; not a general ban on trans visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division minor care ban; national orders target social transition and school staff; parent or guardian traveling with a trans minor faces care restrictions and hostile climate; facility bounty applies in public buildings.
minors_guardians.protection: Division care-ban injunction; some court blocks; no visitor-specific parent prosecution documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Minor's document mismatch can surface at border; care needs in division restricted or under injunction; school orders not directly applicable to a short visit.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Advisories warn safety varies; division hate-crime law excludes gender identity; private bounty incentivizes reporting or confrontation; trans-specific violence counts not documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime law covers gender identity; 22 states plus capital outlaw gender-identity discrimination; division public-accommodations law since 2020.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Private bounty can mobilize ordinary people rather than police; national hate-crime charge possible but state gap and no documented remedy.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Division bounty and facility law not enjoined; passport policy and fraud practice challenged; ID invalidation notices; enforcement and bounty-suit counts unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Active litigation; temporary injunctions on some national orders and minor care; legal-aid FAQ; national hate-crime and anti-discrimination law.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies are pending or partial and not shown to stop border or facility harms; traveler bears unresolved enforcement risk.

anchor_checks.comparison: 0.25-A has actual detention, extortion, and threatened prison with no protection. This dossier has formalized universal facility exposure and border fraud or lifetime risk, but no documented cash extortion and some national remedies, so it is roughly comparable and slightly above.

0.35-A is denial of entry after invasive review but no facility ban or private bounty. This dossier adds universal airport and public-building facility exclusion, civil or criminal penalty, private suit, and border fraud risk, so it rates below 0.35-A.
0.55-B has a temporary delay resolved by a supervisor under guidelines. This dossier's border and facility exposures are mandatory and not shown to be reliably cured, so it is far below 0.55-B.

The division adds a universal public-building facility ban, including airports, enforced by private bounty and civil or criminal penalties, with no documented working injunction. National hate-crime and anti-discrimination law, existing X passports, active litigation, and some injunctions are real but do not reach the facility or border exposures. Minors face care restrictions and injunction uncertainty. The score sits below denial-of-entry-only anchors and near the lower high-risk anchors, above catastrophic imprisonment or execution scenarios.
